name: @zeans/social-flow-mcp-server
description: Built-in MCP server for the social-flow plugin — direct SNS publishing (Threads·Instagram·Facebook·YouTube) + research search (5 SerpApi tools·SNS issue scout·8 Naver Open API types) + image·video·voice·music generation (OpenAI GPT Image·Veo 3.1·Seedance·Gemini TTS·ElevenLabs·Lyria·Suno) + optional on-device MLX Core / mlx-serve (mlx_*)

scripts.build: tsc && node build-video-catalog.mjs && node build-image-catalog.mjs && node build-music-catalog.mjs && npm run bundle && npm run bundle:shot && npm run bundle:mesh
scripts.bundle: esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=dist/bundle.js --banner:js="import { createRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);"
scripts.bundle:shot: esbuild src/astra-shot-runtime.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=dist/astra-shot-runtime.bundle.js --banner:js="import { createRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);"
